chapter_title: Concerning the Three Images that are in the righteous Person
chapter_note: This chapter is almost entirely oldest teaching substrate. After a single-line dialogue frame opening (¶1), the remaining nine paragraphs form a cohesive three-degree anthropological teaching: corporeal → psychic → spiritual images, with a process description of how the living soul ascends through these degrees by divesting itself of what does not belong to it. The teaching is systematic, impersonal, and process-oriented. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system — no editorial bridges, no contemporary application, no institutional content, no exhortation. The light virgin, the new man, the Light Mind, and the three images are all cosmic entities/structures. The negative editorial fatigue score (-2.99) confirms that the later-layer vocabulary is concentrated only in the opening frame, with the rest being clean substrate. One of the purest teaching chapters in the corpus.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure formulaic dialogue frame attribution. 'Once again our enlightener speaks to his disciples' — stereotyped opening with no cosmological content. The dialogue_frame score of 112.5 confirms this is entirely frame vocabulary.

paragraphs.core_text: Three images occur in the elect person.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmological topic statement defining the three-degree structure. The institutional score (28.57) fires on 'elect' — the chapter title uses 'righteous Person,' which may preserve the older term. However, the sentence functions as a structural cosmological declaration: it defines the degree system that the teaching will map. Classified as substrate because the statement describes what IS in the cosmic anthropology, not an institutional prescription.

paragraphs.core_text: The first is the spiritual image, which is the new man, which the Light Mind shall form in him; and it goes into him and dwells in him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First enumeration unit. Maps the highest image → spiritual → new man → Light Mind's formation. Classic degree-mapping: image-type → cosmic entity → process of formation. Both sides internal to the cosmic system. 'The Light Mind shall form in him' describes emanation/indwelling — substrate process vocabulary.

paragraphs.core_text: The second image is the remnant and remainder of the new man, which is the psychic image that is bound in the flesh, as the old man [ ... since the] times of this psychic image.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second enumeration unit. Maps the middle image → psychic → bound in flesh → old man. The 'new man / old man' pairing is a cosmological-anthropological correspondence describing the degrees of mixture. Lacuna preserves manuscript damage. Both sides internal to the system.

paragraphs.core_text: The other one is the corporeal image [that is] added to them all.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third enumeration unit. Maps the lowest image → corporeal → 'added to them all.' The corporeal image is the outermost accretion in the degree structure. Brief because it is the lowest degree — the teaching gives more detail to the higher degrees. Completes the three-fold structure.

paragraphs.core_text: These three images [ ... ] entirely. When it will [ ... ... ] through the nourishment of food. If it shall sink [ ... ... ] down to the corporeal image. [And] the corporeal, [that] is in it, shall divest itself of it and place it in the [ ... ] image. [ ... ] again it rises up and falls to the [ ... ] image; it shall divest itself of the psychical of the enemies, which [ ... ... ] anger. The lust [ ... ... ... ] with it.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Process description of purification through the three images. Heavily damaged but the teaching structure is clear: the living soul enters through food, sinks to the corporeal image, divests itself of corporeal accretions, rises to the psychic image, divests itself of psychic enemies (anger, lust). Classic substrate process vocabulary: cosmic mechanism described step by step. Both sides stay within the system — 'enemies,' 'anger,' 'lust' are cosmic-internal psychic forces, not moral exhortation.

paragraphs.core_text: Then shall a light virgin come and reveal the spiritual image that is [there], which [is] the new man. That virgin acts as a guide. [She g]oes on before and it is extended to the heights above, and received into this spiritual image. And she [sculpts] it and adorns it with the new man [wi]thin. It is sealed with all the limbs of this light virgin who is present and dwells in the new man.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Describes the highest stage of the purification process. The light virgin is a cosmic entity who reveals, guides, sculpts, adorns, and seals the soul within the spiritual image. Every action maps cosmic entity → cosmic process: revealing, guiding, sculpting, adorning, sealing. 'Sealed with all the limbs' is body-cosmos correspondence applied to the virgin's cosmic form. Both sides entirely internal to the system.

paragraphs.core_text: So, this is [h]ow this living limb shall be [puri]fied and live, the one that comes into the body of [the ri]ghteous one from without through the administration of food of various ki[nds], like this. The living soul shall be clea[n]sed entirely every [d]ay and traverse these three [im]a[ges].
paragraphs.temporal_note: Recapitulation of the entire process. 'So, this is how' is a summarizing formula but the content is entirely cosmic-process: living limb → purification → food → three images. 'The righteous one' matches the chapter title's term (vs. 'elect' in ¶2), possibly preserving the older substrate term. 'Every day' describes the ongoing cosmic process frequency, not an anchor to the editorial present. 'Administration of food' describes the cosmic mechanism by which living soul enters the body.

paragraphs.core_text: So, it shall divest itself of the body, which is not its own, in the corporeal. It shall also divest itself of the souls that are not its own, these that are mixed with it in the psychical [ ... ... ] anger and desire and [ ... ]-ness and foolishness and envy and strife; and these other wicked teachings that are not its own.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Detailed process description of what is stripped at each level. Corporeal: 'the body, which is not its own.' Psychic: anger, desire, foolishness, envy, strife — these are the psychic forces of the dark side, cosmic-internal. 'Wicked teachings' likely renders a cosmological term for dark-side impressions/formations rather than being editorial moralizing, given the systematic context. 'Not its own' repeated — formula for distinguishing what belongs to light vs. dark mixture.

paragraphs.core_text: However, in [the] spiritual image itself it shall live and be joined with [lo]ng-sufferingness, the perfection of faith and love that reigns over them all. It is the virgin of light who robes the new man and who shall be cal[l]ed 'the hour of life'. S[he] is the f[irst], but s[h]e is also the last.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Final stage of the teaching: the soul in the spiritual image is joined with cosmic virtues — long-sufferingness (patience), faith, love. These are the virtues/powers of the Light Mind in the Manichaean system, functioning as cosmic entities rather than moral exhortations. The virgin of light 'robes the new man' — cosmic entity performing cosmic action. 'The hour of life' is a cosmic designation. 'She is the first, but she is also the last' — cosmological statement about the virgin's nature spanning the entire degree structure. No voice shift to exhortation or application. Both sides fully internal to the cosmic system.
